# Omni Labs Digital

> Product development, web development and digital marketing for international projects, with a focus on Japan and the Asia-Pacific region.

## Services
- Product concept and development: shaping an idea into a practical digital product.
- Web development: creating and maintaining an online presence.
- Digital marketing: promoting products and services to an audience.
- Blockchain solutions: support for projects involving blockchain technology.

## People
Malte Detjens works across development, marketing and technology. His background includes chemistry, fitness, hospitality, retail and journalism.

## Selected work
- [Grün](https://gruen.jp/): Malte built the physical shop from concept to execution and currently supports business development as an external consultant.
- [HiveMinds LLC](https://hiveminds.co.jp/): Malte is CTO. Asian engineering solutions with project management in Japan and engineering in Indonesia, working in English, Japanese, German and Indonesian.
- [GameDesk](https://staging.gamedesk.space/): player support and live-ops intelligence platform in development; staging preview.
- [TaleFaber](https://talefaber.com/): interactive AI writing platform in development. Authors define worlds, characters and story points; readers shape and publish their completed story runs.

## AI integration and consulting
Company AI consulting, LLM workflows, local machine-learning models trained on client business data, data preparation, system integration and evaluation. Deployment and data access are scoped to client operational requirements.
